selection.rationale: Original Python request trace: 190 data-cache requests, 97 unique blocks, 168 misses at capacity 1; offline FIFO replay predicts 114 at 16 and 98 at 48. 16 caps data at 2 MiB; 48 matches the multithread-built SquashFUSE data slot count. No fragment-capacity, codec, kernel page-cache or workload changes. Memory cost must be measured alongside runtime.
selection.scope: Two explicit candidates, not production promotion. Same resident core, private adapter change only.

vkso-squashfuse.scope: Same runtime section contents and addresses except GNU build ID; rebuild paths/debug metadata differ. Whole ELF files are not byte-identical.

vkso-squash-helper.scope: Same runtime section contents and addresses except GNU build ID; rebuild paths/debug metadata differ. Whole ELF files are not byte-identical.
